meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能操作真实浏览器：按指令打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、滚动页面、截图和读取网页内容，并把结果（截图、数据等）反馈给你。
howto.when: 当用户需要打开网址、填写表单、截图，或其他浏览器操作时触发。

say.note: 浏览器会打开网址并保存截图。

say.text: 填写登录表单，用户名是 user，密码是 123456
say.note: Claude 会在页面上定位输入框并填入。

say.text: 提取这个页面的所有链接
say.note: Claude 会读取页面并列出链接。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can control a real browser: open pages, click elements, fill forms, scroll, screenshot, and read content, returning results like screenshots or data to the user.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to open a URL, fill a form, take a screenshot, or perform other browser actions.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: The browser will open the URL and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill the login form with username 'user' and password '123456'
say_en.note: Claude will locate the inputs and type the values.

say_en.text: Extract all links from this page
say_en.note: Claude will read the page and list the links.
